namana.cp: ger. of namati. (nt.) bending; bowing down.
namana.p: [Nama+yu] (na,thī) CL=7 [In Thī namanā.(namū-saṃ, ṇamaṇa-prā)] (1) Falling (to the sense). (Ti) (2) Fell into the sense. See also - Namanaṭṭha.

nāmana： nāmana（ti）

[နမု+ဏေ+ယု။ （ဏာမန-ပြာ）]
P: Namana，（nt．） [a philosophical term constructed by Bdhgh．from nāma，cp．ruppana-rūpa] naming，giving a name KhA 78； DhsA．52 （see nāma<sup>2</sup>）； Vism．528．（Page 347）

DOP: namana n. , ~ā, f. [ S. namana, n. ], bending; inclining; turning towards ; Dhātup 225 (nama namane); Sadd 412, 27 (namu ~e); — intrans. : Vism 558, 24 (nāman ti ārammaṇābhimukhaṃ ~ato vedanādayo tayo khandhā); Sv 977, 34 (°’-aṭṭhenāpi c’ ettha cattāro khandhā nāmaṃ te hi ārammaṇābhimukhaṃ namanti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se nāmanaṭṭhena) = As 392, 23 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nāmanaṭṭhena) ≠ Paṭis-a 109, 17 ; Paṭis-a 516, 22 (ānamanā ti pacchato ~ā); As 52, 4 (nāmakaraṇaṭṭhena °’-aṭṭhena nāmanaṭṭhena ca nāmaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nāmaṭṭhena °’-aṭṭhena ca); — trans. : Sp 1293, 10 (kāya-bandhanena phāsuke °’-atthāya bandhanti); Sv 649, 19 (pupphite pāricchattake ārohaṇakiccaṃ vā aṅkusakaṃ gahetvā °-kiccaṃ … natthi); — see also nāmana 1 .

1 nāmana n. [ from caus. of namati 1 qv ], bending; turning towards ; Sv 977, 35 (°’-aṭṭhena sabbaṃ pi nāmaṃ cattāro hi khandhā ārammaṇe aññamaññaṃ nāmenti) = As 392, 25 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nāmaṭṭhena) ≠ Paṭis-a 109, 18 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee namanaṭṭhena); As 52, 4 (nāma-karaṇaṭṭhena namanaṭṭhena °’-aṭṭhena ca nāmaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nāmaṭṭhena namanaṭṭhena ca); — see also namana.
